title: A thermal representation for conformal ladder integrals
summary: I discuss the recently discovered representation of conformal four-point ladder integrals in terms of the thermal free energy of free massive scalar fields. These integrals satisfy a novel second-order differential equation in even dimensions $D$ at arbitrary loop order $L$. I also present a simple derivation of the all-loop resummation of conformal ladder integrals for arbitrary $D$. Possible connections to the thermal bootstrap, multiloop calculations, integrability, AdS/CFT and string theory are briefly discussed.
